responsibility: GNU Modula-2 foreign definition module for libiberty’s process-execution helper used by compiler driver style code. It declares the C-facing pexecute entry point that launches a program with an argv vector, supports pipeline/chain control through flags, optional PATH searching and temporary-base handling, and returns either a child identifier or immediate status depending on the host model while reporting launch errors through errmsg_fmt/errmsg_arg out parameters.
